first.rationale: The concurrent decline in onboarding completion and activation makes onboarding simplification the most direct, durable lever for restoring early adoption and qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is relevant to the competitive threat, so its archived evidence should be verified before committing, but discount-led acquisition may be less durable than fixing the observed funnel deterioration.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both declining completion and activation while supporting durable qualified revenue. Signup simplification also showed durable first-week activation gains. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue initially, the verified discounted cohort had 12% lower 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle.
